description: Places de stationnement "Taxi" is a dataset listed in CANNES DATA open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Mairie de Cannes. Places de stationnement réservées aux stations de taxis. Coverage: Cannes. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are Stationnement, Station, Taxi, Places réservées. The portal shows 24 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-cannes-com-portal.
